name: Otsuchi (Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with the Otsuchi town emblem in white and blue: a white disc with pointed edges bearing a blue stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Otsuchi, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 August 1960.

features.role: Otsuchi town emblem — a white disc with pointed edges bearing a blue stylised character
